title: Knowledge
subtitle: Writing, notes, papers, and AI industry observations.

blob-article.title: Personal Blog Archive
blob-article.summary: A blog draft archive for AI productivity, cloud-native AI infrastructure, and engineering practice. It works as a long-running public writing base, with bilingual drafts, images, and topic-based organization that turn scattered experience into shareable material.
points: Organizes writing by topic, including AI productivity, engineering practice, and cloud-native AI infrastructure.
Keeps bilingual drafts and image assets so personal notes can grow into blog posts, Zhihu articles, or other public writing.
Turns tool usage, engineering judgment, and debugging experience into reusable references instead of one-off conversations.

paper-vault.title: Paper Vault
paper-vault.summary: An Obsidian-style paper-reading knowledge base for paper notes, literature indexes, and AI-assisted research workflows. It separates papers, topics, methods, scenarios, datasets, and venues, making it easier to keep accumulating research threads around systems, LLMs, long context, and GPU memory optimization.
points: Indexes papers by topics, methods, scenarios, datasets, and venues so each new note can connect to the existing knowledge graph.
Captures AI-assisted paper-reading and ingest skills, turning paper reading into a repeatable workflow.
Focuses on systems, LLMs, long context, token sparsity, and GPU memory optimization.

ai-builders-digest.title: AI Builders Digest
ai-builders-digest.summary: A daily and weekly digest of ideas, product moves, and signals from AI builders, maintained in Chinese, English, and bilingual versions. Rather than stacking news items, it compresses a high-frequency information stream into material that can be reviewed later.
points: Tracks signals from AI builders across social media, podcasts, and product releases, then packages them into daily and weekly digests.
Maintains Chinese, English, and bilingual versions for both quick reading and cross-language sharing.
Focuses on ideas, product moves, and trend shifts rather than isolated news items.

crater-insights.title: Crater Engineering Insights
crater-insights.summary: A note base for my personal understanding, architectural judgment, and engineering insights around the RAIDS Lab Crater project. It covers accessibility, AI integration, CLI design, infrastructure, job management, and resource monitoring.
points: Externalizes architecture judgment, interaction issues, and engineering trade-offs from Crater platform development.
Covers accessibility, AI integration, CLI design, infrastructure, job management, and resource monitoring.
Uses diagrams and structured notes to explain concrete system issues such as authentication flow, component nesting, and monitoring.
